summary: Advanced Desktop Support Lead/Manager with 15+ years of experience in IT, providing Tier II-III technical support and advanced troubleshooting for United Senate end‑users across multiple platforms.

education.institution: Air Force Air Command and Staff College

experience.title: Administrator of Information Technology
responsibilities: Research, implement, and support new technologies for public policy and 175‑person infrastructure upgrades.
Train staff in support processes and troubleshooting techniques.
Define system specifications and design infrastructure based on user requirements.
Plan, install, configure, and test PC/server hardware, software, LAN/WAN networks, and operating systems.
Monitor and tune system performance; conduct load/stress testing and troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
Develop access controls, disaster recovery policies, backups, and documentation to secure systems.
Prepare users through training programs and ongoing support.
Coordinate upgrades with vendors, test, evaluate, and install enhancements.
Manage budgets and expenses for leadership conferences.
Maintain confidentiality of organizational information.

experience.title: United States Senate Network Support Engineer
responsibilities: Integrated and developed procedures to support third‑party software.
Provided software, printing, and network access support to the Senate community.
Delivered senior‑level support to internal Help Desk operations.
Installed, configured, and supported Capitol Correspond SQL database.
Troubleshot HP printer issues and PC/NT server network connections.
Ensured hardware and software function smoothly; provided cross‑platform desktop support.
Maintained LAN, security systems, backups, and updates.
Performed special projects and recommended technical solutions.

experience.title: United States Senate Software Specialist
responsibilities: Provided Level 2 support for Capitol Correspond database management software on MS SQL.
Installed, configured, and supported Capitol Correspond SQL database.
Trained clients on database usage.
Troubleshot MS SQL and printer issues.
Configured PCs and NT servers to the network.
Delivered desktop support, LAN maintenance, security, backups, and updates.
Conducted special projects and recommended solutions.
